page: Microsoft Azure D48lds_v7 is a low-memory compute and storage-equipped virtual machine instance configured with 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz, backed by an expansive 480 MB L3 cache. With 96 GB of system RAM, the instance implements a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation, positioning it favorably for compute-heavy workloads that do not demand extensive RAM pools.

Hardware capabilities include robust vector and matrix instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX, complementing crypto-acceleration features like VAES and SHA-NI. The instance integrates 2832 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, eliminating reliance on network storage for temporary files, local scratch processing, and low-latency cache pipelines. The configuration does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong processing execution. The instance scores in the top tier for single-threaded gzip compression at 36.36 GB/sec and small-model LLM text generation at 338.79 tokens/sec. Multithreaded bzip3 decompression reaches 302.08 GB/sec, while PassMark database operations and CPU overall scores rank in the top quartile. Networked services benefit from strong static web throughput at 75.8 GB/sec and Redis SET performance reaching 79.57 million operations per second.

By delivering high compute density alongside 2832 GB of NVMe SSD storage, the D48lds_v7 maintains strong cost efficiency for I/O-intensive and processing-centric architectures. It represents an effective hardware tradeoff for web scale serving, continuous integration pipelines, batch compression, and distributed caching, provided the total working dataset remains within the 96 GB memory boundary.
description: Microsoft Azure D48lds_v7 is a compute-focused instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor offering 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores at 4.2 GHz, supported by 480 MB of L3 cache. Designed with a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the instance supplies 96 GB of RAM alongside 2832 GB of high-performance local NVMe SSD storage without integrated GPUs. The instance excels in compute-heavy execution, achieving top-tier throughput in single-threaded gzip compression and small-model LLM token generation, backed by strong scores across PassMark CPU metrics, bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations. Supported by hardware-level Intel AMX and AVX-512 vector acceleration, the D48lds_v7 provides strong cost-to-performance efficiency for database caching, compression pipelines, high-concurrency static web serving, and distributed batch processing requiring high local disk throughput.
